title: Toward a Synchronous Ethereum: Making Rollups Composable with EEZ
description:
Ethereum is becoming an ecosystem of rollups, but they cannot interact synchronously. Dapps and users rely on asynchronous infrastructure, fragmenting liquidity and adding delays, security assumptions, and less seamless experiences.
EEZ offers a different model: contracts on Ethereum and other chains interact synchronously, with calls that return data, revert, and trigger nested calls or callbacks within one atomic operation.
This talk presents EEZ’s architecture, from rollup execution to atomic settlement on Ethereum, and the role of real-time proving in secure synchronous execution, while retaining support for other proving systems. It then introduces Rollup0, the first EEZ-powered based rollup, showing how based sequencing, proofs, and atomic settlement bring synchronous composability to a real rollup.
Finally, we’ll explore EEZ’s potential to reshape how applications, liquidity, and users interact across chains and how EEZ and Rollup0 advance the vision of a Synchronous Ethereum
abstract:
Rollups scale Ethereum, but today they operate as separate execution environments. The absence of synchronous composability fragments liquidity and introduces delays, additional security assumptions, and poor user experiences.
We'll introduce Rollup0, the first rollup of the Ethereum Economic Zone, a protocol for atomic cross-chain execution. Together, they demonstrate how calls can return data, revert, and call back across chains atomically, and how a Synchronous Ethereum can become a reality.
